svg.title: ACCIDDA's 2025-26 influenza scenario projections for the United States
svg.desc: Panel a: projected weekly incident influenza hospitalizations in the United States over 43 weeks from 10 August 2025, under three vaccination scenarios: business as usual coverage, low coverage and no vaccination. Each scenario shows the median across 600 trajectories and a shaded 5th to 95th percentile band; the no-vaccination curve is highest. Panel b: season hospitalizations averted relative to no vaccination, computed per paired trajectory, as box plots for business as usual and low coverage; both are positive, and business as usual averts more.
